title: Ask HN: What are some examples of beautiful software?
guide_zh: 读《黑客与画家》后想找实例：有哪些软件可以称得上“美”？
author: ponderatul
excerpt: So I've been reading Paul Graham's - Hackers and Painters. A bit late, I know. And I find his ideas fascinating. One that struck a chord with me, was the idea of taste, recognising good taste. I'd like to know examples of beautiful software and what makes it beautiful.

title: Ask HN: How much do you make at Google?
guide_zh: 谷歌不同级别、不同地点的工程师，实际能获得怎样的薪酬？
author: googsomeday
excerpt: I don't work for Google, but I would like to. How much do senior software engineers make? What level are you? Do you work at Mountain View HQ, or elsewhere? I don't have much to share, but I make $130K base at a Silicon Valley startup. Options aren't worth anything (yet), but from what I've read on HN, they probably won't be worth anything anyways. title: Ask HN: Moving Out of Silicon Valley because of housing? Where to?
guide_zh: 因住房成本离开硅谷的人搬去了哪里，新城市的技术工作体验如何？
author: Apocryphon
excerpt: Has anyone moved out of SF/SV to work in a different tech city? If so, where? Currently Seattle, New York, Austin, Portland, and Boston/Cambridge seem to be the hot destinations as secondary tech hubs. But their costs of living are likely climbing as well, especially Seattle and Austin. How about Raleigh, how's their startup scene? Or Chicago, Denver, New Orleans, or Nashville? Not to mention cities outside of the U.S.
